fixtures.preview: United host Bournemouth on Sunday after a 4-1 Champions League defeat at Como on Wednesday that left Michael Carrick 'really angry'.
talking_points: Nico Paz scored twice for Como and Joshua Zirkzee's 91st-minute goal was United's only reply, leaving them on 3 points from 3 Champions League games.
Carrick said the Como performance was not acceptable and that he 'didn't like what I saw', so the pressure on him is rising.
Lisandro Martínez left the Leeds game early and is a doubt for Sunday; Kobbie Mainoo (about 10 more days) and Luke Shaw (longer) are out, and Rashford has a hip problem.
Matthijs de Ligt made his first start in 325 days at Como, while Benjamin Sesko's recovery is unclear.

fixtures.preview: A 12:30pm UK trip to Stamford Bridge on Saturday 31 October, moved from the 3pm slot for UK TV.
Matchday 4 of the Champions League league phase brings Roma to Old Trafford, with United on 3 points from 3 games.
A Sunday 4:30pm UK home game against Aston Villa, picked for TV.
The trip to Anfield is set for Sunday 22 November at 4:30pm UK time, live on Sky Sports in the UK.
A Sunday 3pm home game, part of a double-header with Sydney FC Women v Melbourne City at 5:45pm.
talking_points: Sydney opened with a 0-0 derby draw against Western Sydney, and coach Patrick Kisnorbo called the effort a foundation to build on.
Adelaide are coached by Airton Andrioli; I couldn't find their form or any team news for Sunday.
Sydney's Australia Cup run ended with a 0-2 semi-final loss to Melbourne Victory on 9 September.

Real Madrid beat Leipzig 4-1 on Wednesday, so they arrive in better form.

notes: Searches were thin and many sites blocked access (HTTP 403/404/429), so several sections are shorter than their limits rather than padded.

Man Utd: the Como result and team news (Martínez doubtful, Mainoo and Shaw out) are from Sky Sports and OneFootball; Carrick's Bournemouth press conference wasn't readable. The Liverpool kick-off is now confirmed as 4:30pm UK on 22 Nov (Liverpool FC). The Chelsea, Roma and Villa details come from club-news and UEFA listings; I dropped league positions because I couldn't re-confirm them.

Sydney FC: the Melbourne City (31 Oct) and Mariners (6 Nov) times weren't re-checked this run and come from Wikipedia and Austadiums; the 6 Dec Victory time isn't published. Paramount+ is listed as the broadcaster but the A-Leagues guide doesn't say so explicitly. No Adelaide team news was found.

Big matches: Stan Sport has the Premier League and Champions League. beIN Sports is listed for the Clásico based on its earlier LaLiga coverage, but I couldn't confirm the broadcast for this specific game. Liverpool v Arsenal comes from Liverpool FC's fixture update, which I didn't re-open. Champions League 9pm CET start times are UEFA's default where no time is stated. The Wallabies' November Tests had no confirmed Australian broadcaster, so they were left out.

Live sport: Kings start times (3pm Sunday) come from Austadiums, not the club. No Matildas, Socceroos or Waratahs games in Sydney and no tennis in the next 4 weeks were found (the Matildas play Colombia in Canberra on 28 Nov).

Local: no local news from the past 7 days could be found apart from the school-street note, and South Eveleigh's events page had no 2026 content. School events come from the downloaded Term 4 calendars and the Week 2 updates; the other school's public site had no Term 4 events.

Not found: Pokémon, Minecraft or Roblox events in Sydney this month, a confirmed kids' fun run or junior parkrun near home, Sydney matcha pop-ups with current dates, football-boot or running-shoe sales, retailer events (EB Games, Kinokuniya, Dymocks) and ticket deals for kids' shows.

Groceries: the Woolworths and Coles half-price lists for the 21 Oct week weren't accessible, so most items show a special price with no was-price. The Aldi tuna price comes from the Spring catalogue, which runs to 30 Nov.

Deals: items come from the OzBargain listing pages, with prices and expiries as listed there. Previous-run deals that couldn't be re-checked were dropped, and the Pitt Street Mall coffee giveaway has no end date or details.
